subject: science
concept: Understanding the basic path of digestion from mouth to waste elimination
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sequences organ cards (mouth, stomach, intestines) in the correct order food travels
exercise.pictorial: Student labels a simple digestive system diagram in order
exercise.abstract: Student explains what happens to food at a described stage of digestion

misconception_flags: places digestive organs out of their actual sequential order

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
